decisions.reason: Space navigation and observation camera builds directly on the firm's established optical and camera expertise, so absorptive capacity to interpret results and improve is high.
Modular space navigation camera also leverages core camera and electronics knowledge, allowing the firm to assimilate feedback and refine the product.

Space situational awareness sensor suite integrates multiple sensors but remains within the firm's electronic and optical capabilities, and its own website page indicates commitment and learning potential.

Miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR sensor is more distant from the firm's traditional camera and sensor lines and was only mentioned on the website, suggesting weaker ability to evaluate and improve it, though R&D cooperation may still provide the needed knowledge.
